Mercury-gravity Manometer
The mercury-gravity manometer consists of a calibrated cartridge glass tube that is
optically clear, easy to clean, and abrasion resistant. The mercury reservoir at the
bottom of the tube communicates with a compression cuff through a rubber tube.
When air pressure is exerted on the mercury in the reservoir by pumping the
pressure bulb, the mercury in the glass tube rises and indicates how much pressure
the cuff applies against the artery. The manometer is connected to the wall for
ease of accurate visualization.
